resources.string: The text printed in your photos (receipts, labels, documents, screenshots) is what makes them findable by their words. Choose where it is read.
Read here, from the photo itself, before it is sent: small print reads best. Syncing takes a little longer on slower phones. Photos already indexed keep the text they have.
Read by Opensolr from the smaller copy the phone sends: syncing is lighter on the phone, small print reads less well. Photos already indexed keep the text they have.
